textbookBox.concept: The ciliary muscles change the focal length of the lens. This is the power of accommodation. The near point is 25 cm and the far point is infinity.

beats.en: The ciliary muscles change the focal length of the lens. This is the power of accommodation. The near point is 25 cm and the far point is infinity.
beats.speakEn: The ciliary muscles change the focal length of the lens. This is the power of accommodation. The near point is 25 centimetres and the far point is infinity.

beats.en: Myopia (short-sightedness): distant objects look blurred because the image forms in front of the retina. It is corrected by a concave lens.
